definitions.ask: Should the coder prove the fix on a real macOS runner with scripts/dev/macos-ci-check before finishing?
definitions.why: Linux never compiles this cfg branch; macOS lint has hidden its tests for 20+ master pushes

choices.label: Push a throwaway ci/precommit branch and wait up to ~90 min for real macOS lint proof
Finish after Linux checks; the next master CI run is the first macOS proof
